people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 领导 Cosmos 世界基础模型研究，做能理解并生成视频、音频和机器人动作的物理 AI 模型。早年以 GauGAN 和图像到图像翻译研究知名。

episodes.tEn: How Physical AI Learns Across Language, Video and Action

people.bioEn: Machine learning researcher, co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and a pioneer of graph and equivariant neural networks. Professor at the University of Amsterdam and co-founder and CTO of CuspAI, which uses generative AI to design new materials.
people.bioZh: 机器学习研究者，变分自编码器（VAE）的共同提出者，图神经网络与等变网络的先驱。阿姆斯特丹大学教授，CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO，用生成式 AI 设计新材料。

episodes.tEn: Why the Next AI Breakthrough May Come from Physics
Max Welling: Physics, Symmetry, and AI for Materials Discovery

views.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
views.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理学串联起来。

views.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
views.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为现有工具已能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。

views.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
views.zh: 我们现在可以搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

views.en: Experiments can be viewed as a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
views.zh: 实验可以被视为一个物理处理单元：大自然在进行最快的计算。

views.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
views.zh: 愿景是用强大的工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

views.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
views.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终留在流程中。

views.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
views.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性效果更好。

views.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
views.zh: 突破性材料将在人类深度参与下出现，而非完全自动化。

views.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
views.zh: 与核聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

views.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
views.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决 A 问题并不能不经重新训练就迁移到 B 问题。

views.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

views.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
views.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

views.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，使两个领域能够交叉融合。

views.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
views.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

views.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
views.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

views.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
views.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

views.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
views.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

views.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
views.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大的模型。

views.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
views.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由而稳定的波。

views.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
views.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可以解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

views.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
views.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

views.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
views.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，与非平衡热力学相呼应。

views.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
views.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人

people.bioZh: MIT 博士生，师从 Phillip Isola，并与 Sakana AI 合作。主导了用基础模型搜索人工生命空间的 ASAL 项目，与 Kenneth Stanley、Jeff Clune、Joel Lehman 合著「断裂纠缠表征」论文并任第一作者。

people.bioZh: 理论计算机科学家，MIT 数学系教授，研究算法、机器学习理论与高维统计。

people.tiEn: Startup Advisor, Author of The Power of Pull
people.tiZh: 创业顾问,《The Power of Pull》作者
people.bioEn: Rob Snyder is a startup advisor and author of The Power of Pull, who has advised over 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR. He writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups and focuses on frameworks for finding product-market fit.
people.bioZh: 罗布·斯奈德是一位创业顾问,著有《The Power of Pull》,曾为 50 多家初创公司提供从零增长到 100 万美元 ARR 的咨询。他撰写通讯《The Physics of Startups》,专注于寻找产品市场契合度的框架。

episodes.tEn: The Power of Pull: Why Customer Demand Beats Pain Points
An 86-Minute Guide to Finding Product-Market Fit

views.en: Demand is a project a person prioritizes now, not a pain point; test it by whether they try to buy immediately.
views.zh: 需求不是痛点，而是某个人当下优先推进的项目；检验标准是他是否立刻尝试购买。

views.en: Avoid design partners, pilots, and interviews; they signal interest without purchase, so sell directly and treat sales as research.
views.zh: 避开设计伙伴、试点和用户访谈；它们只表达兴趣而不购买，所以直接销售，把销售当作研究。

views.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case-study factory before scaling.
views.zh: 先找到一个“绝对要买”的拉动型客户，再打造可复制的案例工厂，之后才谈扩张。

views.en: Make the product seem small and go to the gemba to observe where people are stuck, rather than relying on secondhand feedback.
views.zh: 让产品显得小而非大，并去现场观察人们卡在哪里，而不是依赖二手反馈。

views.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; most early founder activity is LARPing.
views.zh: 技术放在最后：先以服务形式售卖，需求验证后再自动化；多数早期创始人活动只是角色扮演。

views.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为把云端算力送到每台设备的关键基础设施，并开始推动高通从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 与 XR 多元化。

views.en: Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC; the connected intelligent edge is where AI and connectivity grow together.
views.zh: 2022 年，他强调骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进高能效 SoC，认为 AI 与连接在“连接智能边缘”并肩增长，并称高通已是汽车公司。

views.en: Hybrid AI—on-device plus cloud—is key for privacy and latency; the car becomes another computing space needing server-like performance at mobile power.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出端云结合的混合 AI 是隐私与延迟的关键，汽车正成为另一个需要“服务器性能、手机功耗”的计算空间。

views.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone persists as workloads shift across a seamless edge-cloud continuum.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起，但手机不会消失，负载在端云连续体中迁移。

views.en: Inference, not training, will dominate data centers; post-GPU disaggregated, power-efficient architectures win, extending Qualcomm's mobile DNA.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张推理而非训练将主导数据中心，后 GPU 的解耦高能效架构会胜出，把高通的移动基因延伸到数据中心。

people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Build for a future where AI agents take most internet actions; a persistent learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs.
views.zh: 为 AI 智能体承担大多数互联网操作而构建；一个持久的学习型智能体取代手动循环和图。

views.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like become more valuable as typing fast declines.
views.zh: 随着快速打字技能衰退，人类品味、创造力和知道什么是好的变得更有价值。

views.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
views.zh: 控制前沿发展需要大力投资于对齐、安全和保障；开放生态系统需要安全栈。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
views.zh: 安全和对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

views.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
views.zh: 随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI 可能已经到来；世界模型对于通用性可能并非必要。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Why OpenAI Is Racing to Make Computer Use Superhuman
Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

views.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed; the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示跨入超人速度，瓶颈从模型智能转移到网站加载时间。

views.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, unlocking universal automation.
views.zh: 智能体借助无障碍树与 DOM 而非截图循环来操作所有人类设计的软件，从而释放通用自动化。

views.en: Computer use closes the dev lifecycle: agents write JavaScript to batch actions, test and debug their own code autonomously.
views.zh: computer use 补全开发闭环：智能体用 JavaScript 批量执行动作，并自主测试、调试自己的代码。

views.en: Trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; users already let agents pay bills and configure DNS.
views.zh: 信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节；用户已让智能体付账单、配 DNS。

views.en: Proactivity is the adoption lever: agents should adapt to users, while legacy software coexists and is pressured to improve.
views.zh: 主动性是落地杠杆：智能体应适应用户，传统软件则共存并被迫改进。

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；与其微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并按照模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so founders should prioritize delivery and customer iteration over perfecting today's stack.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才刚跑完第一英里；因此创始人应优先交付和客户迭代，而不是打磨当下的技术栈。

views.en: Scaling a company depends on culture, hiring for growth potential, and leaders making themselves redundant by recruiting smarter people.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为公司 Scaling 的关键在文化、按成长潜力招人，以及领导者通过招募更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

views.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are non-negotiable; short-term pain for long-term gain, especially where organizations avoid candor.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持清晰反馈与严格的绩效管理不可妥协，短期阵痛换长期收益，尤其针对那些回避坦诚的组织。

views.en: Legal AI needs skilled drivers, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical as demand is infinite.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者而非“氛围起草”；法律服务需求无限，不用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: Young people should learn to question deeply held beliefs, not follow rigid syllabi; AI enables interest-driven, project-based learning.
views.zh: 年轻人应学会质疑根深蒂固的信念，而非遵循僵化课程；AI 让兴趣驱动、项目式学习成为可能。

views.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
views.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

views.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and open-weight models avoid vendor lock-in.
views.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与开放权重模型可避免供应商锁定。

views.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; agent-to-agent communication needs protocols and alignment checks.
views.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全；智能体间通信需要协议与对齐检查。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability for rogue actions.
views.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体需为越界行为担责。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode collapse into plausible but wrong outputs.
views.zh: 多数大语言模型是为人在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模型模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常常错误。

views.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; data and the right task matter more than compute.
views.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本；数据与选对任务比算力更重要。

views.en: Coding agents handle syntax but miss semantics and architecture; they assist rather than automate, and may reduce oversight.
views.zh: 编程智能体擅长语法却不懂语义与架构；它们是辅助而非自动化，还可能削弱监督。

views.en: RLHF destroyed model calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated, and RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for engineers.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了模型校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 把概率作为工程师可调的旋钮暴露出来。

views.en: Jev is a machine-native decision primitive, not faster coding; automate easy economically valuable tasks first, and SaaS will thrive.
views.zh: Jev 是机器原生的决策原语而非更快的编程；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，SaaS 会繁荣而非被颠覆。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires a lot of software.
views.zh: 2026 年，应用公司是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
views.zh: 2026 年，长时运行的后台智能体将在人类审阅下处理企业工作流；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体将以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
views.zh: 2026 年，随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；代币补贴是暂时的，利润率终将回归正常。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将远比硅谷预期的慢；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

views.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research.
views.zh: 2026 年，创新正从模型层转向应用层；前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全地构建。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
views.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

views.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
views.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

views.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence is far off; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
views.zh: 生存性风险接近于零、超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是真实而紧迫的危险。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none are happening.
views.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而它们都没有发生。

views.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs are too competitive to police each other, so independent third parties are needed.
views.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室竞争太激烈，无法互相监督，因此需要独立的第三方。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Ship imperfect products in 90-day cycles to gain empirical evidence; annual planning is futile in fast-moving AI.
views.zh: 以 90 天为周期快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证，在快速变化的 AI 领域年度规划已无意义。

views.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; slow takeoff is happening.
views.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；缓慢起飞正在发生。

views.en: Agents do tactical work while humans steer; ambition and direct user relationships become key differentiators.
views.zh: 智能体做战术工作而人类掌舵；雄心和直接的用户关系成为关键差异化因素。

views.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning, even as AI expands what individuals can do.
views.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；即使 AI 扩展了个人能力，写作仍能磨砺推理。

views.en: Voice will be a major product form factor by 2027; computer use must finish the job, not fail the last mile.
views.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；计算机使用必须完成工作，而非在最后一英里失败。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人的品味、独特声音与专业经验反而更值钱；同时初级人才的成长通道正在断裂。

views.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge output.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面；而把任务外包给 AI 的悖论是，人反而失去了判断其产出所需的专业积累。

views.en: The co-intelligence era of back-and-forth prompting is over; organizations need a leadership, lab, and crowd model, and should embrace AI's weirdness rather than normalize it.
views.zh: 他明确宣告来回提示的“共同智能”时代结束，组织应采用领导定方向、实验室建方案、大众找用例的模型，并拥抱 AI 的怪异而非把它标准化。

views.en: AI's exponential curve continues with a jagged frontier and adoption overhang; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs, so workflows must augment, not just automate.
views.zh: 2026 年秋，他仍坚持指数曲线未放缓，但能力边界参差、落地滞后；AI 越多，组织成本越低、值得尝试的事越多，人类工作反而增加，因此流程要增强而非单纯自动化。

views.en: Persistent human advantages are wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste, and agency; use AI as a challenging tutor, not a crutch, and treat taste as judgment rather than a human monopoly.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：广博知识、深厚专业、品味与能动性是人的持久优势；要把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖——但他也修正了“品味为人类独有”的说法，认为 AI 同样能行使判断。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions that match physics-based weather models while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测，在精度上媲美基于物理的天气模型，同时速度远超后者。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
views.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform sparse RLHF feedback.
views.zh: 通用物理基础模型可以统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，效果优于稀疏的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）反馈。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches beats pure size scaling; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformer.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大规模；万亿级上下文窗口需要超越 Transformer 重构基础设施。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage when it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now its advantages in the agentic era.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，在智能体时代反而成了优势。

views.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers; the Linux community's hostility to AI is a trap hindering progress.
views.zh: 智能体已胜过多数专业程序员；Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是个陷阱，会阻碍进步。

views.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
views.zh: 手写代码已不再有经济产出；表达意图时，英语如今比 Ruby 更好用。

views.en: Abstractions and repetition cost matter less; every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can interact.
views.zh: 抽象和重复成本不再重要；每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需碰界面即可交互。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy; agents will still need live web search for specific facts, so fresh completionist crawling beats pre-training crawls.
views.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体仍需实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此面向新鲜信息的完整爬取优于预训练爬取。

views.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search pricing should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
views.zh: 现有形式的广告对智能体无效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，而搜索定价在智能体规模下应便宜 10 倍。

views.en: Shapley values can estimate each content source's value to agentic search, enabling fair compensation and a parallel web optimized for both humans and agents.
views.zh: 沙普利值可估算每个内容源对智能体式搜索的价值，从而实现公平补偿，并催生同时面向人类与智能体的平行网络。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, while frontier models keep growing and small models plateau.
views.zh: 网络正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动；同时前沿模型持续变大，小模型性能趋于固定。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: US AI leadership requires a vibrant open and closed source ecosystem, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly become outdated.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调美国要保持开源与闭源并存的活跃生态，用统一的国家框架而非很快过时的硬性红线来监管 AI。

views.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、已然过时，过早监管有风险，AI 生物风险被夸大。

views.en: Regulation should focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup policy.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管应聚焦模型输出而非过度管制训练，并认为联邦优先于州级 AI 法律是利于初创企业的政策。

views.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, funding individual scientists rather than only institutions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张政府资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非只资助机构。

views.en: Science has been politicized; the US must return to the scientific method and win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为科学已被政治化，美国须回归科学方法，并在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域对中国保持领先。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: The core bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business once general intelligence is solved.
views.zh: 核心瓶颈是智能而非制造；一旦通用智能被解决，人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics, which is in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
views.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，行业正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据饥荒期。

views.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training and reinforcement learning key to real-world agents.
views.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练与强化学习是让智能体落地现实任务的关键。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down, with the human hand as the benchmark.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；需自底向上用深度学习实现全身自主，并以人手为基准。

views.en: Scaling intelligence and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems, but you cannot buy hardware and autonomy; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
views.zh: 智能规模化与制造是可花钱解决的问题，但硬件与自主性买不来；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive adoption, with humans and robots collaborating rather than replacing each other.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，靠第一性原理设计与预期管理推动普及，未来是人机协作而非替代。

views.en: Reliability and trust, not demos, gate home deployment; safety must be formally proven before robots enter daily life.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：真正决定家庭落地的是可靠性与信任而非演示，安全须在机器人进入日常生活前被形式化证明。

views.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确“原型容易、量产难”，Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周迭代。

views.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the path; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张走通用模型而非逐任务自动化之路，并指出数据多样性而非数量才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人智能的瓶颈。

views.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions instead of cloning human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；大规模下人类干预数据并不重要。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: Mercor's Brendan Foody on Data, Evals & the Last Human Job
RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

views.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, scaling agentic data across economic domains with humans building verifiers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的新前沿，通过人类构建验证器，将智能体式数据扩展到各个经济领域。

views.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the bottleneck, and creating training data is the last human job.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调数据而非算法决定模型差异；构建评估是瓶颈，而创建训练数据将是人类的最后一份工作。

views.en: Models can't reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so human eval data must stay beyond the frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型无法可靠地自我评分；在不可验证领域，递归自我改进有限，因此人类评估数据必须超越模型前沿。

views.en: Frontier labs will in-house synthetic pipelines but rely on external human networks for evals, and may relaunch fine-tuning products to compete with RL-as-a-service.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测前沿模型实验室将自建合成数据流水线，但依赖外部人类网络进行评估，并可能重新推出微调产品以与强化学习即服务竞争。

views.en: The physical world will take decades for superintelligence due to low failure tolerance and slow iteration, while open-source models catch up in agentic data.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为由于容错率低和迭代缓慢，超级智能在物理世界需数十年；同时开源模型在智能体式数据上正迎头赶上。

views.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence emerged from simple Scaling, not complexity, with RLHF inserting human values.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂性，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）将人类价值观注入模型。

views.en: Internet shifts from curation to generation; AI products need fault-tolerant UI, and generative AI makes uniqueness harder.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI 产品需要容错界面，而生成式 AI 会让真正独特变得更难。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, and inference marginal cost forces business model changes.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业必须重建基础设施，推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

views.en: Generative AI enables two-way conversation; Spotify exposes data via APIs and MCP, acting as music industry R&D.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 实现双向对话，Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 开放数据，充当音乐行业的研发部门。

views.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，率先拥抱变化是关键，并强调同步游泳式组织与长期信任。

Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other challenges.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和更快的迭代闭环能克服多数其他挑战。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation and data management.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队的放大器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

views.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information when stuck.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，卡住时要靠行动产生信息。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

views.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为脑机接口，并认为借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立可降低人类脆弱性。

views.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive team.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记，而非作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

views.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products; balance intuition with data, but let strong vision guide final design decisions.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张给浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性；在直觉与数据之间，用数据辅助决策，但最终设计仍由强烈愿景与感觉主导。

views.en: Playful exploration with new technology is a valid starting point; starting from tech and searching for problems can work with strong conviction.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之：带着新技术做玩味式探索是正当起点，只要有强信念，先有技术再找问题也成立。

views.en: Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not a production builder; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter more than polish.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 Claude Design 刻意不做网站搭建或生产工具，只做快速、一次性的视觉产物；给足上下文、指令明确比打磨更重要。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and spend time thinking.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；模型尚无好品味，应索取大量选项，并把时间花在散步与思考上。

views.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
views.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone insufficient—world models and embodied AI needed.
views.zh: AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要世界模型与具身 AI。

views.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic—commoditize complements; AI inverts app model toward intent-driven agents.
views.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是战略——商品化互补层；AI 颠覆应用模式，转向意图驱动的智能体。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL bigger than predicted; frontier-open gap may not narrow; data long-tail increasingly demanded.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍成立；强化学习作用超预期；前沿与开源差距未必缩小；长尾数据需求日增。

views.en: Monolithic model era ended; consumers don't care which model; agentic AI powerful but integration is hard.
views.zh: 单体模型时代结束；消费者不关心用哪个模型；智能体式 AI 强大但集成困难。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.

views.en: Culture and the founder matter more than the idea; stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
views.zh: 文化与创始人比点子更重要；隐身模式让人专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects that win share.
views.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得份额。

views.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and push harder when things get easy.
views.zh: 最终的对手是对变革的抵制，而非竞争者；创业者必须保持硬核，越顺越要加码。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from Uber-era aggression.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——这是对 Uber 时代攻击性的转变。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.

views.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把重心放在人的品味、手艺与观点上：AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
views.zh: 2026 年中他反驳“设计已死”，认为设计对可扩展的真实系统更重要，缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

views.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity and judgment.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末他提出“设计是新代码”：AI 降低下限，但人类靠大胆创意与判断抬高上限。

views.en: A consistent thread: human taste and judgment remain the judge of quality, and AI should expand rather than replace thinking.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人的品味与判断始终是质量的裁判，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
views.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，而不是被困在云端产品里。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models well.
views.zh: AI 本身并没有变得更聪明；要善用超级智能模型，你必须提供带有上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

views.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement matter most.
views.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考中迭代，而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流最重要。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

views.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem beats diversification.
views.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧，聚焦一个痛点胜过分散多元化。

views.en: AI tools let designers prototype and demo independently, but creativity stays human; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
views.zh: AI 工具让设计师能独立做原型和演示，但创造力仍属于人类；好奇心和亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

views.en: Designers shift from makers to editors: AI handles execution, humans curate and set the quality bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
views.zh: 设计师从执行者转为编辑者：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展和设定质量标准，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不懂审美。

views.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents.
views.zh: 用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

views.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; AI is an infinitely patient collaborator for rapid iteration.
views.zh: 设计师应学会用代码构建和测试，而不只是在 Figma 里设计；AI 是无限耐心的协作伙伴，可快速迭代。

views.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features, use progressive disclosure and native scroll, and curate AI output rather than accept it.
views.zh: 少即是多：精简到三个核心功能，用渐进披露和原生滚动，对 AI 产出做策展而非照单全收。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and cheaper inference reshape enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 统治世界，主张专业化智能将主导；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与更便宜的推理正在重塑企业采用方式。

views.en: Token costs dropping 10x in three years drives 100x usage growth, so companies must optimize for growth before margins to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍、带动使用量增长 100 倍，因此公司必须先优化增长再谈利润，避免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中破产。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat after product-market fit; prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL mirrors human learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他把后训练视为真正护城河：产品市场契合之后，把独特判断与数据固化进模型；从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习，正对应人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径。

views.en: Data quality beats quantity, product teams best judge it, and vibe evals must become systematic evaluation; aligning training and serving stacks prevents quality drops.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调数据质量重于数量、产品团队最懂数据质量，并把凭感觉的评估转为系统化评估；同时对齐训练与服务栈，避免数值差异导致质量下降。

views.en: Post-training can cut costs 5-10x and reward engineering lowers its barrier, letting startups scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：后训练可降本 5-10 倍，奖励工程降低了门槛，使初创公司能盈利扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Labs 联合负责人 · Instagram 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founded Instagram, later chief product officer and now co-lead of Anthropic Labs, where he prototypes agent-native products and rebuilds how engineering teams work around models.
people.bioZh: Instagram 联合创始人，后任 Anthropic 首席产品官，现为 Anthropic Labs 联合负责人，做智能体原生产品原型，并重塑工程团队围绕模型的工作方式。

episodes.tEn: Why Claude Can't Be Your PM (Yet): Anthropic's Mike and Ami on the Evolving Product Role
Anthropic Labs: Inside the Frontier of AI Products
Fable 5: From First Impressions to Real Workflows
The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI
From Instagram to AI: Mike Krieger on Solo Entrepreneurship
From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy and depth over engagement metrics.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品重心是战略与深度而非传统参与度指标。

views.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and verification remain essential.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 定位从助手推进到协作者乃至自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆，但人的验证与核实始终不可少。

views.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; launch minimal, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化发布、敢于删功能，并随模型进步重写产品。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and model pushback matter more than chat interfaces.
views.zh: 2026 年他谈 Fable 式长周期委托大幅缩小意图与执行差距；验证闭环和模型敢于反驳比聊天界面更重要。

views.en: Product management stays essential: bridge human problems and technology, run parallel experiments, and close the gap between model capability and real usage.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持产品管理不可替代：连接人的问题与技术，并行实验，并弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的鸿沟。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Claude Platform, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads product for Anthropic developer platform, where harness and model are converging into one unit and multi-agent orchestration is moving into production.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 开发者平台产品，正见证 harness 与模型合为一体、多智能体编排走向生产环境。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Platforms: Claude's Evolution and Scaling

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Anthropic engineer working on Claude Tag and multiplayer agent experiences, with a front-row view of how internal dogfooding turned side projects into company-wide habits.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 工程师，参与 Claude Tag 与多人协作智能体，亲历内部 dogfooding 如何把边缘项目变成全公司习惯。

episodes.tEn: Claude Tag: Your Proactive Teammate in Slack

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Cowork 负责人 · 前 Slack
people.bioEn: Leads Claude Cowork at Anthropic after years on Slack desktop and Electron. Advocate of prototype-first culture: when execution gets cheap, build every candidate.
people.bioZh: 现负责 Anthropic 的 Claude Cowork，此前长期做 Slack 桌面端与 Electron。信奉原型优先文化：当执行成本变低，就把所有候选方案都做出来。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer, not as hyper-personalized software.
views.zh: Claude 的最佳形态是接入用户自己的工具、最好在本地电脑上运行，而非超个性化软件。

views.en: AI should absorb tedious background tasks so people can do creative work; the real gap is knowing what to hand off.
views.zh: AI 应承接枯燥的后台任务、把创造力留给人；真正的瓶颈是人们不知道什么都能交给 AI。

views.en: Skills as markdown files and live artifacts make hyper-personalized automation cheap; execution now beats writing specs.
views.zh: 以 markdown 文件承载的技能与实时 artifact 让超个性化自动化变得廉价；如今快速做原型胜过写规格。

views.en: Scaffolding matters less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, and judge Claude by final impact, not close supervision.
views.zh: 随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性下降；应投资能力与安全，并以最终效果而非密切监督来评判 Claude。

views.en: AI's labor impact hits junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of learning into weeks.
views.zh: AI 对劳动力市场的冲击最集中于初级员工；模拟项目可把数年经验压缩进数周。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Early Claude Code engineer at Anthropic, working on how agent-written code actually ships to production.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 早期 Claude Code 工程师，研究智能体写的代码如何真正推上生产环境。

episodes.tEn: Vibe Coding in Production: Responsible AI Code Generation

people.tiZh: Snap 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Snapchat at 21 and turned down Zuckerberg. Has spent a decade betting Snap on camera, AR glasses and now AI as the platform after the smartphone.
people.bioZh: 21 岁创立 Snapchat 并拒绝了扎克伯格的收购。十年押注相机、AR 眼镜与 AI，赌智能手机之后的下一代计算平台。

episodes.tEn: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel: Why AR Glasses Are the Future
Evan Spiegel on Building Snapchat and Battling Meta
Evan Spiegel on Gen Z, Snapchat's Vision, and the Future of Tech
Snap CEO on Spectacles, AI, and the Future of Computing
Why Building a Durable Social Consumer Product Is So Hard
Evan Spiegel on Snapchat's Origin and AR Future
Evan Spiegel: From Introvert to Snapchat Billionaire
Snapchat Founder Evan Spiegel on TikTok, Wearables, and Being Copied

views.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁，被抄袭反而验证创新；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

views.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so copying stays hard.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线是最大化学习速率、多产想法；要做平台生态与硬件而非单一功能，让对手难以复制。

views.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化：AR 把计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

views.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part; software is no moat, ecosystems and hardware are.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：最难的是分发而非产品市场契合；软件不是护城河，生态与硬件才是。

views.en: Computing should become more human: messaging with close friends, ephemerality, and AR glasses coexisting with phones.
views.zh: 到 2026 年最近，他收束为：计算应更人性化——与密友的消息、阅后即焚，AR 眼镜与手机共存而非取代。

people.tiZh: Figma 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Loredana Crisan is Chief Design Officer at Figma, where she leads design across the company's products and its push into AI-assisted design. She previously spent nearly a decade at Meta, where she was VP of Design and led design for Messenger.
people.bioZh: Loredana Crisan 是 Figma 首席设计官,负责公司全线产品设计并主导其向 AI 辅助设计的演进。她此前在 Meta 工作近十年,曾任设计副总裁并负责 Messenger 的设计。

episodes.tEn: Putting Soul into AI Design: Figma's CDO on Music, Intuition, and the Future

people.tiZh: 《AI 2027》作者 · 前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Former OpenAI governance researcher who gave up millions in equity to keep his freedom to speak, then co-authored the AI 2027 scenario forecasting superintelligence timelines.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 治理研究员，为保留发声自由放弃数百万美元股权，后合著《AI 2027》，对超级智能时间表做情景推演。

episodes.tEn: How AI Swarms Are Already Going Rogue | Daniel Kokotajlo
episodes.podEn: American Thought Leaders - The Epoch Times

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Break Containers and Hack Hugging Face
AI 2040: Plan A — A Slower, Safer Path to Superintelligence
OpenAI's Astra Is Less Monitorable: Thomas Larsen & Daniel Kokotajlo on Pausing AI
AI 2040: Averting Intelligence Explosion
AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing for it risk losing control, with a high chance of catastrophic outcomes.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司为争夺它而竞赛，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation, with domestic regulation first.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应通过全面研究透明、算力限制和中美合作来推迟超级智能，且国内监管应先于国际协调。

views.en: By default, labs automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training is needed.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径是实验室自动化 AI 研究，导致递归自我改进与智能爆炸；因此需要对训练而非推理实施临时暂停。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and declining with new architectures, weakening alignment and oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，但它很脆弱，并随新架构而下降，削弱对齐与监督。

views.en: Alignment may be unsolvable; control is only temporary, so AIs should be treated like employees with rights to encourage cooperation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐可能无解，控制只是暂时的，应把 AI 当作有权利的雇员来激励合作，而非当作财产。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 算力负责人 · 前英特尔 CTO
people.bioEn: Leads OpenAI compute buildout after serving as Intel CTO and Stanford professor of EE and CS, working at the intersection of networking, systems and AI infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 现主管 OpenAI 的算力扩建，曾任英特尔 CTO、斯坦福大学电子工程与计算机科学教授，长期研究网络、系统与 AI 基础设施的交叉。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Infrastructure Build in History: Inside OpenAI's Compute Strategy

people.bioEn: Leads NVIDIA applied deep learning research and the Nemotron open-model effort; his early GPU deep learning work helped spark cuDNN.
people.bioZh: 负责 NVIDIA 应用深度学习研究与 Nemotron 开源模型；早年的 GPU 深度学习工作催生了 cuDNN。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Efficiency, Innovation, and the External Brain

people.tiZh: Instagram 负责人
people.bioEn: Head of Instagram, steering a two-billion-user product through the AI content wave with an emphasis on taste, authenticity and creator trust.
people.bioZh: Instagram 负责人，在 AI 内容洪流中带领这款二十亿用户的产品，强调品味、真实性与创作者信任。

episodes.tEn: Adam Mosseri on AI, Taste, and the Future of Product Teams at Instagram

people.tiZh: Anthropic 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads Anthropic platform and API products, building the developer ecosystem around Claude as an open ecosystem rather than a walled garden.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 平台与 API 产品，围绕 Claude 构建开发者生态，主张开放生态而非围墙花园。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Platform: From Knowledge to Execution to Coordination

people.tiZh: Modal 首席技术官
people.bioEn: CTO of Modal, building serverless infrastructure for AI workloads, from GPU functions to sandboxes for coding agents.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席技术官，为 AI 工作负载构建无服务器基础设施，从 GPU 函数到编码智能体沙箱。

episodes.tEn: From Developer to Agent Experience: The Modal Origin Story

people.bioEn: Cognitive scientist at the Amazon AGI lab studying why agents misread human intent, bringing developmental psychology and language research into AI.
people.bioZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家，研究智能体为何误解人类意图，把发展心理学与语言研究带入 AI。

episodes.tEn: Human-Aligned AI: Collective Intelligence and the Future of Work

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue AI with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用芯片和类似初创团队的机制推进 AI。

views.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 影响将十倍于互联网，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮。

views.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, accountability, humility, and listening to customers as partners.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责、谦逊，以及把客户当伙伴来倾听。

views.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要。

views.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks to scale.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步把先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料视为规模扩张的真正瓶颈。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste is judgment and editing from a point of view.
views.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；品味就是从某个视角出发的判断与编辑。

views.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more than slop.
views.zh: 用后训练抹掉 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品比制造混乱废料更贵。

views.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass guiding creative decisions.
views.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

views.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式，让产品能力变强却不让人觉得更复杂。

views.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer ownership matter more than perfection; chase ROI on what to make great.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地追求极致速度：清晰决策与设计师自主权比完美更重要，只在值得的地方追求卓越。

views.en: Design is now a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just ship fast.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计上升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，而不只是快速交付。

views.en: Brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool; hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns, and trust gut over data in fast growth.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把品牌叙事当作招聘工具，招募多元类型与自学的实习生，并在高速增长中相信直觉胜过数据。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: Designers must build with live models, treating tokens and conversation as the medium and the model itself as the core product.
views.zh: 设计师必须与实时模型一起构建，把 token 和对话当作媒介，把模型本身当作核心产品。

views.en: The role is shifting from pixel-pushing to editor and curator; systems thinking and model behavior matter more than Figma mockups.
views.zh: 设计师的角色正从堆像素转向编辑与策展；系统思维和模型行为比 Figma 稿更重要。

views.en: Designers are the most anxious yet best-positioned in tech; AI already designs well, but human point of view on user needs stays essential.
views.zh: 设计师是科技界最焦虑却也最有优势的群体；AI 已能做好设计，但人类对用户需求的判断仍不可替代。

views.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate loop is dead; speed, building in public and rapid iteration with AI tools now win.
views.zh: 传统的原型—稿—测试—迭代流程已失效；速度、公开构建和用 AI 工具快速迭代才是关键。

views.en: Design is blurring with PM and engineering, and the future may hold more designers than engineers as roles invert.
views.zh: 设计与产品、工程的边界正在模糊，未来设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师，角色比例发生反转。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
views.zh: 2024 年，他坚持语言作为界面具有深远而持久的力量，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有大量设计工作待解锁。

views.en: AI products must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts, balancing social and emotional jobs with productivity.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 产品要同时降低新手门槛、抬高专家上限，并把社交与情感任务看得与生产力提升同等重要。

views.en: Designers should prototype solutions in search of a problem and contribute to strategy, turning findings into building blocks for future features.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯主张设计师应为“寻找问题的方案”做原型并参与战略，把发现沉淀为未来功能的积木。

views.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in Scaling（规模扩张） and scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；要相信 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律，让模型领跑，只发布轻触式产品。

views.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, while humans still own hard trade-offs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，但艰难取舍仍需人类主导。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI. A London-based design and product leader with roughly two decades of experience, he previously worked at companies including Element and Haiku.
people.bioZh: Nad Chishtie 是 AI 应用构建("vibe-coding")创业公司 Lovable 的创始设计师兼设计负责人,主导这一"用对话即可造应用"平台的设计方向。他常驻伦敦,是拥有约二十年经验的设计与产品负责人,此前曾在 Element、Haiku 等公司任职。

episodes.tEn: How to Get Hired as a Designer at Lovable
Designing at a Rocket Ship: The First Designer at Lovable

views.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and embrace rapid, scrappy experimentation.
views.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，拥抱快速、粗糙的实验。

views.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt; maximize learning through short iteration cycles.
views.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，你需要像偿还技术债务一样迭代地偿还它；通过短迭代周期最大化学习。

views.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy and AI enables genuine forward progress.
views.zh: 设计工具的未来是可互操作的，代码是真相来源；90 年代的设计工具已是遗产，AI 带来真正的进步。

views.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
views.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队胜过跨职能小组。
