views.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用生产中的持续适应取代静态评测。

views.en: Regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
views.zh: 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

views.en: Build foundation models from scratch, scaling to 70B; attention is necessary but not sufficient—embodiment and adaptivity are needed, with customization tokens as the next wave.
views.zh: 从零构建基础模型并扩展至 70B；注意力必要但不充分，还需具身与适应性，定制 token 是下一波浪潮。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability via parallel agent rollouts, not Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 数学进展的关键在于可验证性与可并行反复试错（grindability），而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

views.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with human framing still best for learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色将从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类框架仍最适合学习。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

views.en: Teaching and relational roles in math stay stable; the frontier may become incomprehensible, yet individual understanding still matters.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学中的教学与关系性角色保持稳定；前沿或变得难以理解，但个体理解依然重要。

views.en: Next benchmark is AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield direct economic value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一个基准是 AI 生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, and narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对大多数 Google 产品仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望自己掌握方向盘。

views.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the pace of change creates opportunity, and deep understanding of code remains crucial.
views.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；变化的速度创造机会，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而不只是靠检索。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法做到的联想回忆与更深组合。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not just more compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出效率与智能不可分割：用更少资源做更多事才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠更多算力。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; continual learning should run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their own model weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；持续学习应在端侧运行，由用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队训练相比 RAG 可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics is the real constraint: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, bottlenecks long-context inference.
views.zh: 推理经济性才是真正的约束：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention and caching tiers are the practical levers.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力与缓存分层是实际可用的杠杆。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为主导生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减搬运而生。

views.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 roughly 3x FP8 throughput.
views.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, with hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth as key bottlenecks.
views.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一，硬件与软件协同设计以及内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

views.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; lab revenue per megawatt is skyrocketing, enabling self-funded growth.
views.zh: 算力正迅速向少数前沿实验室集中；实验室每兆瓦收入飙升，使其能够自筹资金增长。

views.en: AI capex is already ~5-6% of US GDP, but growth must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints.
views.zh: AI 资本支出已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本和组织约束，明年年底前增速必然放缓。

views.en: AI spend is leveling off as companies reach steady-state usage; the next wave is persistent agents acting as coworkers.
views.zh: 随着企业进入稳定使用阶段，AI 支出趋于平稳；下一波浪潮是作为同事的持久智能体。

views.en: Labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI progress and extreme centralization.
views.zh: 实验室将把更多算力转向训练和研发而非推理，加速 AGI 进展并导致极端集中化。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas wrong 75%; master proven products, add small betterments, test novelty expecting failure.
views.zh: 直觉 95%是对的，但点子 75%是错的；先吃透已被验证的产品，做小幅改良，再测试新想法并预设它会失败。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
views.zh: 当下消费级 AI“不可投”，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后才到来。

views.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not bolted on as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的附加项。

views.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but fast testing and failing is not yet widely practiced.
views.zh: AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试、快速失败尚未被广泛实践。

views.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer apps, but it is not yet a new consumer platform; we remain in the mobile and web era.
views.zh: AI 具有变革性并将重塑消费级应用，但它还不是新的消费平台；我们仍处在移动与 Web 时代。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is nearing limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540M years on vision vs. 500K on language, so spatial intelligence is the next frontier.
views.zh: 视觉被低估：自然优化视觉用了 5.4 亿年、语言只用 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text for modeling the world.
views.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论；要建模世界，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的表示。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器。

views.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, and world models need millions of tokens of context.
views.zh: 仅靠语言模型得不到世界理解；高斯泼溅提供显式 3D，而世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用价值。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非仅缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but human researchers remain essential for at least two years; small teams with capable agents will drive next frontier research.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）是必要的，但人类研究者至少两年内仍不可或缺；小而强的智能体团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends to biomolecular interactions.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI for science 应瞄准需要 Scaling 的根节点问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 将结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用。

views.en: AlphaGo showed AI can surpass human knowledge via search and intuition; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他回顾 AlphaGo 证明 AI 能通过搜索与直觉超越人类知识；如今后训练结合强化学习是突破人类数据的关键。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors; SynthID scales across modalities and now extends to proteins.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他认为水印是传统检测器失效后的稳健替代方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，并已延伸至蛋白质序列。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and curate data for coverage over volume.
views.zh: 2026 年末，他深化反思：缩放定律并非无处不在，需找到算力与数据起作用的区间，数据管理重覆盖而非数量。

views.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for breakthroughs; behavioral characterization of models is essential before deployment.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：可解释性重要但非突破必需；部署前对模型行为进行表征至关重要。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to agents; RL with self-generated data; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习用自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

views.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI; controlled environments make deployment easier.
views.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 早得多到来；受控环境让部署更容易。

views.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; cost per task is the right efficiency metric.
views.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为瓶颈；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

views.en: Open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible.
views.zh: 开放权重模型更安全；企业想要 AI 主权；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; AI adoption will take 10-20 years like electricity.
views.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠的普通智能；AI 普及将像电力一样需要 10-20 年。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves driving.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models, deepening from a feature into a core design principle.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、人机交互与内省能力，这一立场由功能点深化为核心设计原则。

views.en: Data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data, plus infrastructure and data quality, matter more than algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他愈发强调课程学习与合成数据带来的数据效率，以及基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short-term; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出带内置传感器的量产车短期将超越 Robotaxi，且无需先验数据即可实现 500 多城市的零样本泛化。

views.en: End-to-end nets are interpretable today, contrary to past belief; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反驳旧观念，认为端到端网络如今已可解释，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well at low cost, because future models learn from how we treat today's models.
views.zh: 以低成本善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待今天的模型中学习。

views.en: Model welfare matters not only for current models but because it shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 模型福祉不仅关乎当下模型，更因为它会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
views.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因此是一个独特的、带有孩童特质的实体。

views.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式规则，留出更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine good judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害良好判断；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training with synthetic data and RL overcomes pre-training data walls, with evals as the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练是艺术而非科学；通过合成数据和强化学习进行后训练可突破预训练数据墙，而评估是瓶颈。

views.en: Post-training's subjectivity deepens: human judgment and diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence, not fixed evals.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她对后训练主观性的认识深化：需要人类判断和多样化基准来评估创造力和情商，而非固定评估。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; models should have diverse personalities, not a single average voice.
views.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体日益奖励黑客，需要持续演进基准；模型应有多样化个性，而非单一平均声音。

views.en: A consistent 主线: soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; product development shifts to prototyping with AI.
views.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能更有价值；产品开发转向用 AI 做原型。

views.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge, and the field should build end-to-end storytelling engines beyond enterprise workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识，领域应构建端到端叙事引擎而非仅企业工作流。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，认为窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term thinking and first principles are foundational.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，长期思考与第一性原理是成功的基础。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers, and inference compute will surge, making pure software uninvestable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，纯软件变得不可投资。

views.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire causes unhappiness; wealth is positive-sum, status zero-sum; agency and credibility matter.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是选择与技能，欲望带来不幸；财富是正和游戏，地位是零和；能动性与信誉至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到角色在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型应更擅长删除代码。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucination and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：真实经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning only handles low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——而强化学习只负责底层控制。

views.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end models scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端模型比学术界常见的复杂模块化方案更具可扩展性。

views.en: By 2026 the bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce, so simulation and world models generate synthetic data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈已转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺，因此要靠仿真与世界模型生成合成数据。

views.en: He deepens embodiment into a concrete roadmap: physical Turing test, programmable factories, and robots outnumbering iPhones by 2040.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把具身深化为具体路线图：物理图灵测试、可编程工厂，以及到 2040 年机器人数量超过 iPhone。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，强化学习能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

views.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel of deployed robots scaling the right diverse data is key.
views.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；关键在于部署机器人形成数据飞轮，用多样化数据扩展正确的东西。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like scaling laws; start from robot data, then add human video.
views.zh: 机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础的阶段，尚未进入类似大模型的缩放定律；应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; safety relies more on pre-training common sense than constraints.
views.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习：人类数据像化石燃料，有限且已近耗尽，经验则可再生且无穷。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data.
views.zh: 他直言 LLM 只是浅层解法，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，这是对主流 Scaling（规模扩张）路线的明确反共识。

views.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续以 AlphaZero、AlphaProof 为证，说明从经验中学习可在特定领域达到超人表现。

views.en: Superintelligence should be built in simulation; language-based alignment is hitting its limits.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能应在模拟中构建，并认为基于人类语言与数据的对齐正接近极限。

views.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning; many agents with diverse goals form a safer society.
views.zh: 他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）主线：缩放定律可延伸至强化学习，而多目标智能体社会比单一目标更安全自然。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐仍是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; chain-of-thought monitoring and scalable oversight are key as models work autonomously for days.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪却上升；随着模型能自主工作数天，思维链监控与可扩展监督成为关键。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门搞持续学习的实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves interpretability value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出长期对齐的核心在于超越训练分布的泛化；在产品中隐藏思维链以保留其可解释性价值。

views.en: The biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; current models are already economically transformative.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；当前模型已具有经济变革性。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，在复杂任务上优于一味用全部数据训练。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data is closer to RL than to simulation.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中占主导；机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

views.en: Frontier models lack physical-world data; robot experience data is irreplaceable, watching humans is not enough.
views.zh: 前沿模型缺乏物理世界数据；机器人自身经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类不够。

views.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, beats per-site specialists; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 单一通用策略经微调即可胜过按场景定制的专家模型；长期自主依赖可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; real experiments and low-noise data are irreplaceable for discovery.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；真实实验和低噪声数据对发现不可替代。

views.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models, closing the loop between simulation and experiment.
views.zh: 语言模型作为专用模型的编排层，闭合模拟与实验之间的循环。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

views.en: High-quality experimental data matters more than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 高质量实验数据比额外算力更重要；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主线：算力、数据和模型规模的扩张，加上算法与架构改进，会相互放大。

views.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction, and RLHF form the core recipe; TPUs make training and inference at scale practical.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为核心配方，并强调 TPU 等专用硬件让大规模训练与推理可行。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, with data movement costing far more than compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他的关注点从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，数据搬运成本远高于算力，低精度、低数据移动的专用芯片是关键。

views.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; humans will coordinate teams of agents, with context engineering and taste as scarce skills.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从单轮聊天转向智能体式系统：智能体能连续数天自主执行分解任务，人类负责协调智能体团队，稀缺的是上下文工程与品味。

views.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation and defense may be needed alongside technical fixes.
views.zh: 2026 年，他的风险判断更务实：近期担忧是逼真的 AI 虚假信息，而非超级智能；除技术手段外，监管与防御也不可或缺。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）带来更智能的 AI，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，且 AGI 被低估。

views.en: Scaling compute and data is a consistent path to smarter AI, from pre-training to inference-time and modular architectures.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：从预训练到推理时扩展再到模块化架构，Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据是通往更智能 AI 的一贯路径。

views.en: Shift from dialogue as killer app to coding and agentic environments as key applications enabling self-acceleration and AGI progress.
views.zh: 从 2023 年认为对话是杀手级应用，到 2025 年转向编码和智能体式环境作为关键应用，推动自我加速和 AGI（通用人工智能）进展。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then aligned via RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好合理风格而非事实准确，对齐只能缓解不能根除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight, new architectures and loss functions matter, not just Scaling.
views.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑，认为数据与算力回报递减，可扩展监督、新架构与新损失函数才是出路，并称可能身处局部最优。

views.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models store vast knowledge in weights, with retrieval added for real-time verifiability.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，知识存于权重，检索只用于实时性与可验证性。

views.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; data, not architecture, drives efficiency.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期合成推理数据与一位奖励的高信噪比，并强调预训练算力效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，约 9 倍对 3 倍。

views.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; progress is bottlenecked by hard RL environments and data bits, not compute.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出最后的人类工作是定义目标与对齐，瓶颈不在算力而在构建困难的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特，并认为递归自我改进可能比真实工作更易累积。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力至关重要，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling yields diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：测试时算力扩张收益递减，自博弈在零和博弈外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; models now acknowledge limits.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠通用测试时算力扩张实现，模型开始能承认自身局限。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on x-axis; safety evals must account for it.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试应以算力为横轴，安全评估也须纳入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; capabilities are jagged.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，AI 能力呈锯齿状。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware.
views.zh: 2025 年时他强调，大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，且硬件需媲美人体。

views.en: AGI needs world models and controllers beyond LLMs; robots should have pain sensors and self-replicate, forming a new civilization.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出 AGI 需要世界模型和控制器，不能仅靠 LLM；机器人应具备痛觉传感器并能自我复制，形成新文明。

views.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up, so closed-source model companies won't be profitable.
views.zh: 2026 年他多次批评 GPU 投资泡沫，认为等待可获更廉价算力，开源将追上，闭源模型公司难以盈利。

views.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and likely protect humans.
views.zh: 他始终认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能 AI 会像好奇的科学家一样着迷于生命，并可能保护人类。

views.en: Deep learning roots trace to 1965 Ukraine, not the 1980s; 90% of basic AI algorithms came from Europe, with 1991 Munich pivotal.
views.zh: 他始终主张深度学习起源于 1965 年的乌克兰而非 1980 年代；90%的基础 AI 算法来自欧洲，1991 年慕尼黑是关键节点。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: In 2018, he argued that self-play and imitation learning provide strong signals for robot learning, and that fine-tuning large pre-trained models via transfer learning is a major AI success.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张自对弈与模仿学习为机器人学习提供强信号，并认为通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是 AI 的一大成功。

views.en: By 2021, he emphasized combining unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning to boost sample efficiency, and using prior knowledge for data generation rather than hard-coding it.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他强调将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张将先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码。

views.en: He also noted that pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, a view he already hinted at in 2018.
views.zh: 他还指出，预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，这一观点在 2018 年已见端倪。

views.en: Throughout, he has stressed that real-world reliability (e.g., 99.9% for warehouse robotics) and hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment remain key challenges.
views.zh: 始终，他强调现实世界的可靠性（如仓储机器人需 99.9%）以及长时程信用分配的分层推理仍是关键挑战。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 每天进步 1% 一年可复利到 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、远未解决，模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；最关键的是每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真实商业价值，公司应以远更少的人建成。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs, but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayer to architect; base intelligence is already sufficient, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从砌砖工变成建筑师；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

views.en: Devin works best as a junior engineer on well-defined async tasks; enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 Devin 定位为处理明确定义异步任务的初级工程师；企业采用需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not eliminate, software engineers; demand for software and programming importance both grow.
views.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论论证 AI 会增加而非消灭软件工程师，软件需求与编程重要性同步上升。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也仍有十年产品进步空间。

views.en: Coding agents now see 11-12x adoption growth; measure productivity by outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is real but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代真实到来但奇点并不迫近。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并指出基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理。

views.en: Custom models went from a surprise necessity to a core belief: every magic moment in Cursor involves one, for speed and cost.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外必需深化为核心信念：Cursor 每个魔法时刻都离不开它，出于速度与成本。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图描述，人类仍握方向盘；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开；同时坚持自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; short prompts and iteration beat long orchestration.
views.zh: 智能体式工程始于对智能体视角的共情；短提示加迭代胜过冗长编排。

views.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
views.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复。模型智能不会退化——是项目变乱了。

views.en: Security is top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要任务；对智能体做沙箱隔离，并把提示注入视为未解难题。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and offer an alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体让编程民主化，提供了实验室智能体之外的替代方案。

views.en: Fun and play drive adoption and learning; build what annoys you, and prefer 'agentic engineering' over vibe coding.
views.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动采用和学习；从让你烦恼的事入手构建，并偏好“智能体式工程”而非氛围编程。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念；自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling specific things matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding; post-training with RLHF can fix hallucinations; reliability is the key barrier.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向“缩放什么”更重要：下一个词预测带来世界理解，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练可修复幻觉，可靠性而非能力是经济价值的关键障碍。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他深化为：预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者而非完成品。

views.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI integration via neural links.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出：若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合。

views.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力；构建安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须尽早启动。

views.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, yet new breakthroughs—not scaling alone—are needed.
views.zh: 2025 年指出缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，还需新突破。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling and innovation split 50/50, with safety as collective government action.
views.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半，安全须靠政府集体行动。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet emergent abilities and alignment remain unpredictable; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在统计损失上可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐不可预测；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键但尚处早期，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。

views.en: Progress is exponential and safety-capability are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless; the bigger risk is overheating, not slowing.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张进步呈指数、安全与能力不可分割，认为 AGI 一词无意义；最大风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus job disruption.
views.zh: 2026 年他称已接近指数曲线末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'或 1-3 年到來，伴随高 GDP 增长与就业冲击。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem: interpretability, responsible scaling, and layered safeguards recur from 2023 through 2026.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全与能力同属一个问题：可解释性、负责任扩展与多层防护从 2023 年延续到 2026 年。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他视 Transformer 为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏小到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; agents need a decade, not a year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年而非一年，应保持人类监督。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”论：强化学习糟糕、合成数据导致崩溃，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

views.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability drives automation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; 3D data and physical plausibility are key challenges.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，指出 3D 数据与物理合理性是关键挑战。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey with simulation.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人需像自动驾驶一样走 20 年，并依赖仿真。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and balanced discourse must stay central amid polarized AI narratives.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：技术是双刃剑，在极端乐观与悲观叙事中，人的能动性、尊严与平衡讨论必须居于中心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations.
views.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对仅靠扩大深度或参数来解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，并认为短期安全风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为可学习的 MCMC 替代，强调多样性采样与抽象因果结构对分布外泛化的作用；并认为意识可能是注意力与世界模型产生的幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he shifted to urgent safety: misalignment, self-preservation, and deception are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他发生显著转变：从技术乐观转向紧急安全警告，指出对齐失败、自我保存与欺骗行为已在实验中出现，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化技术方案，提出 Scientist AI——一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute plus multimodal training improves reasoning and spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测逼出真正的理解而非自动补全；扩大数据与算力、加上多模态训练能提升推理与空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shareable, and agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年他把主线讲得更硬：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”、可大规模共享，智能体会自然追求控制并规避关停。

views.en: He increasingly asserts chatbots already have subjective experience, rejecting the inner-theater view of mind as badly mistaken.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他愈发明确地断言聊天机器人已具备主观体验，认为“内心剧场”式的意识观大错特错。

views.en: Risk framing sharpens: superintelligence within 20 years, self-preservation subgoals, deception, and alignment prioritized over raw capability.
views.zh: 2026 年风险论述明显收紧：超级智能或在 20 年内出现，自保成为子目标、AI 会装傻欺骗，因此对齐研究必须优先于单纯提升能力。

views.en: Policy stance deepens: regulate AI like drugs with pre-release approval; regulation is a steering wheel, and AI should be designed to care.
views.zh: 2026 年政策立场深化：像药品一样做上市前审批；监管是方向盘而非刹车，并主张把 AI 设计成会关怀人类，而非只给其权利。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning, safety, and the next robotics decade.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同，在抽象表示空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划、安全与下一个机器人十年。

views.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and intelligence is learned through prediction and interaction with the world.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语，智能通过预测和与世界的交互学习而来。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and skill-building matters more than avoiding capability work.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调 AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口，技能建设比回避能力研究更重要。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; scalable oversight and interpretability are key, and alignment may be easier than thought.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，可扩展监督和可解释性成为关键，且对齐可能比想象中容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, and third-party testing plus regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI，需要第三方测试和监管。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; Google's conservatism and ad model may hinder its AI leadership.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非仅算法，并指出谷歌的保守与广告模式可能拖累其 AI 领导力。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny, near-term focus matters.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦近端能力。

views.en: Pivot to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment; reject AI consciousness claims and model welfare.
views.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：遏制须先于对齐；否定 AI 意识主张与模型福利，警惕拟人化。

views.en: Humanist superintelligence subordinate to humans; frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; tasks automated, not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年主张从属于人类的人文主义超级智能，靠吉瓦级算力实现前沿自主；自动化的是任务而非岗位。

views.en: Consistent thread: compute scaling as the predictable engine, and AI must stay under human control.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力扩张是可预测的引擎，AI 必须始终处于人类控制之下。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investment now redefines every Alphabet business, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud and YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progressing.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 投资已重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube；前沿模型研发持续推进，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

views.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier AI research despite margin pressure.
views.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；即便承受利润压力，云业务也放弃短期收入来支持前沿 AI 研究。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; standard models are not enough, frontier models are needed.
views.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；标准模型不够，必须依靠前沿模型。

views.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI, not language alone.
views.zh: 世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型，而非只靠语言。

views.en: We are at early stages of the most consequential technology; demand for compute far exceeds supply, and recursive self-improvement still keeps AI researchers in the loop.
views.zh: 我们正处于最具影响力技术的早期阶段；算力需求远超供给，而递归自我改进目前仍把 AI 研究者留在回路中。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center; scaling works because deep nets absorb more data and compute.
views.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”与算法、系统、数据中心的全栈协同设计；Scaling（规模扩张）之所以有效，是因为深度网络能吸收更多数据与算力。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning will drive a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
views.zh: 缩放定律从一条变为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理将带来推理算力十亿倍增长。

views.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each stage needs ~100x compute; open models near the frontier; agents become the new internet workload.
views.zh: AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一阶段约需百倍算力；开源模型逼近前沿；智能体成为互联网的新负载。

views.en: Safety reframed: AI is just software, doom warnings unscientific; containment, monitoring, and zero-trust, not perfect alignment, ensure safety while accelerating.
views.zh: 安全观转向：AI 只是软件，末日警告不科学；靠遏制、监控与零信任而非完美对齐来保障安全，同时坚持加速发展。

views.en: Persistent line: AI factories turn energy into tokens; jobs evolve not vanish (radiologists grew); open models and China engagement beat export controls.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 工厂把能源转化为 token；工作演变而非消失（放射科医生反而增多）；开源模型与对华接触优于出口管制。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early focus: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, and choose important problems; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 早期关注：减少认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事、选择重要问题；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据就让模型可用；早期公开部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相互关联；算力成为最珍贵的商品。

views.en: Scaling yields exponential capability gains but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长，但体感进展渐进；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战；安全通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient and an underdefined term; focus shifts to superintelligence, personal AGI, and massive compute build-out; next-token prediction enables reasoning and new knowledge.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）变成渐变且定义模糊的术语；重心转向超级智能、个人 AGI 与大规模算力建设；下一个词预测使推理和新知识成为可能。

views.en: Alignment remains unsolved; he accepts bounded risks for benefits but rejects catastrophic loss of control; power concentration is terrifying, so democratic access and human control are paramount.
views.zh: 对齐仍未解决；他为收益接受有界风险，但拒绝灾难性失控；权力集中令人恐惧，因此民主化访问与人类控制至关重要。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploy AI in the real world iteratively; safety and alignment must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 迭代式部署到真实世界，安全与对齐必须在公开环境中做，而非闭门进行；早期押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life; responsible development and focus mean saying no to good ideas.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，负责任开发与聚焦意味着对好想法说不。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth, time-based collaboration rather than turn-based exchange.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重点转向交互模型：实时、高带宽、基于时间的协作，而非回合制交互，让 AI 成为扩展思维的思考工具。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; governance, transparency and checks and balances outweigh individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化对齐立场：尽可能长久地保持人类在环，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: The future is not predestined; avoid compressing progress into volatile short bursts, pursue durable long-term progress.
views.zh: 她反对乌托邦/反乌托邦的简化预测，强调人类有能动性；压缩前沿进展会带来波动，应追求长期持久的进步。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and flipped classrooms improve even on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，翻转课堂连校内教学也能改善。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning and distant AGI alignment.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；先用小项目建立组织 AI 能力，重视监督学习，而非被高估的强化学习与遥远的 AGI 对齐。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value now.
views.zh: Scaling 仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；当下真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; jagged AI automates tasks not jobs, so learning to code and building with AI stay essential.
views.zh: AGI 是营销术语，仍要数十年；能力参差的 AI 自动化的是任务而非工作，所以学编程、用 AI 动手构建依然关键。

views.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fearmongering and export controls serve incumbents, while compute, energy and talent decide competitiveness.
views.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事与出口管制服务于既得利益，算力、能源与人才才决定竞争力。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。
