views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法。反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表征学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous. Fear narrative dominates, but sober discussion is needed.
views.zh: AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制 AI 目标是危险的。恐惧叙事主导，但需要冷静讨论。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: learning from experience with goals. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 强化学习是核心范式：有目标地从经验中学习。LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

views.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象和持续深度学习。

views.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience; the field is weird, not me.
views.zh: 持续学习至关重要；LLM 训练后就停止学习。合成数据无法替代真实世界经验；是领域奇怪，不是我奇怪。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early on, scaling plus engineering and iterative training drive progress; AGI is plausible but needs careful initial conditions and alignment via human preferences.
views.zh: 早期他强调工程与迭代训练：硬件加速会推动 Scaling（规模扩张），AGI 虽可期但需谨慎设定初始条件，并通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

views.en: Scaling alone is not enough for reasoning; chain of thought and post-training refine base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
views.zh: 从 2019 到 2025 年，他明确 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新思路；后训练把预训练基座模型打磨成稳定可用的行为。

views.en: Bottleneck shifts from algorithms to compute and energy; scaling laws show no wall, and compute becomes the scarce resource and basic right.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源；缩放定律看不到墙，算力成为稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，OpenAI 以租算力再转售的简单商业模式支撑需求。

views.en: AGI reframed as a gradual spectrum, not a moment; agents grow proactive and persistent, with safety, security and alignment as first-class, scaling bottlenecks.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐进光谱而非某个时刻；智能体走向主动、持久，安全、安保与对齐成为与能力同步设计的一等要求，并成为进步瓶颈。

views.en: Humans stay in the driver's seat; the best interface is almost no interface, and domain expertise plus trust earned through gradual delegation are the durable moats.
views.zh: 贯穿到最近的访谈，他坚持人类掌舵：最好的界面是几乎没有界面，领域专长与通过逐步授权赢得的信任才是持久护城河，AI 应放大而非取代人的目标。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality and small efficient models matter.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多 token 而非一味做大模型；数据质量与小而高效的模型同样关键。

views.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency gains and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率提升与数据质量同等重要，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI means control over data, infrastructure and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与落地：AI 应被拥抱并去中心化，主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 是增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization and agentic platforms, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
views.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与智能体平台，预训练正撞上饱和墙。

views.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window to build independent AI infrastructure and strategic autonomy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他坚持 AGI 是方向而非终点，并警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施与战略自主。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把完全快速可复用视为火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

views.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party referees; lying to AI, even for good ends, is the core risk.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调 AI 安全需要追求真理的 AI 与第三方裁判；让 AI 说谎——哪怕出于善意——才是核心风险。

views.en: Civilization's real threat is population collapse and government waste; AI and robots become the only fix for debt.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他转向认为文明真正的威胁是人口崩溃与政府浪费，AI 和机器人成为解决债务的唯一出路。

views.en: We are in the singularity: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 80-90% good odds but 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他宣称已身处奇点：数字超级智能可能几年内到来，80-90%概率向好，但有 10-20%毁灭风险。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; truth, curiosity, beauty are what we can instill.
views.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 推理与数据中心转向太空；人类无法控制 AI，只能灌输真理、好奇心与美。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure pushes smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习让推理模型在每单位算力上收益更高；经济压力推动部署更小更便宜的模型。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓，驳斥放缓叙事；但前沿模型仍在幼儿能解的简单任务上失败。

views.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化思考：推理、强化学习与工具能解难题但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式才学得概念，不同于人类从少量例子泛化。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出强化学习跨域泛化但有锯齿边缘需仔细监督；编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；系统黑客等近期风险比存在风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Early ML work frames learning via hypothesis classes, losses, and evaluation; notes neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 早期机器学习研究以假设空间、损失函数和评估方法为框架；指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；架构影响甚微；AGI（通用人工智能）将在 4-50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling（规模扩张）; bigger models aren't safer; agents bring new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
views.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的显式训练与多层防御；更大模型并不更安全；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; interpretability may become real science via coding agents.
views.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过编码智能体成为真正的科学。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

views.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度内的成功率衡量）是瓶颈，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and compute becomes the major bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），而到 2028 年算力将成为主要瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing teams of AI agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排和工具更重要，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT giving most gains and RL adding reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练视为将工业配方压缩为开放方法：SFT 贡献九成性能，强化学习补上推理与角色。

views.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）视为后训练最大突破，但指出过度优化与工程系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

views.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, lagging closed frontier by 6-9 months; compute gaps may widen US-China divergence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化开放模型主线：开放模型是研究与主权 AI 的引擎，落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月，算力差距可能拉大中美分化。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will matter most.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非无限算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）反而影响最大。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades, and post-training on proprietary data beats raw compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非石油，强调未来两三年决定未来几十年，用专有数据做后训练比堆算力更重要。

views.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability, and there is no US-China research gap.
views.zh: 2024 年他坚持数据是算力之外的最大瓶颈，认为智能体式 AI 的障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并称美中实验室已无研究差距。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with data as strategic national asset.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他确认缩放定律继续有效，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing matter, and personal agents are the consumer endpoint.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向超级智能临近的判断，强调安全、可扩展监督与选择性开源，并认定个人智能体才是消费级终点。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are his constant product principles, already stated in 2025 and repeated through 2026.
views.zh: 潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建，是他贯穿始终的产品原则，2025 年已提出，2026 年反复重申。

views.en: His claim escalates from AI writing most code to 100% of his own code, with per-engineer productivity rising from 70% to 250%.
views.zh: 他的说法从 AI 写大部分代码，升级到自己 100% 的代码由 AI 写；人均生产力从 70% 升到 250%。

views.en: The engineer role shifts from writing code to a builder blending product and design; coding is increasingly solved.
views.zh: 工程师角色从写代码转向融合产品与设计的“构建者”；编码正被逐步解决。

views.en: Safety stays central, but his framing evolves from holding releases to treating Claude Code itself as a safety research tool.
views.zh: 安全始终是核心，但他的框架从推迟发布，演变为把 Claude Code 本身当作安全研究工具。

views.en: His prescription deepens from giving agents tools to writing loops and dynamic workflows that orchestrate thousands of sub-agents.
views.zh: 他的方法论从给智能体工具，深化为编写循环与动态工作流，编排数千个子智能体。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, as rapid model improvements make long-term roadmaps obsolete; product taste becomes the top skill.
views.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 的规划周期从数年缩短到一个月，产品品味成为最核心的能力。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs internally.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，转而专注产品品味与商业判断；内部 Claude Tag 已贡献 65% 的产品 PR。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying on model judgment instead of hard rules.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型自身的判断。

views.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature; new models become drop-in replacements while preventing regressions in code review and behavior.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与评测套件成为每个功能的门槛，新模型可即插即用，同时防止代码审查与行为上的回退。

views.en: Rewrites are now safe—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully.
views.zh: 重写代码库如今是安全的——代码库即规格——外层改动可让人类退出代码审查，由 Claude 全权审查。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架允许的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态规格；更精简、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

views.en: Spend more upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and prompting is the meta-skill.
views.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，提示词是元技能。

views.en: Frontier models will become Pareto dominant, doing simple tasks with fewer tokens; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
views.zh: 前沿模型将帕累托占优，用更少 token 完成简单任务；把控前沿节奏是每个工程师应理解的技术问题。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；独立验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and kindness; mission alignment and speed drive culture at Meta and Anthropic.
views.zh: 领导力在于实时的一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和善意；使命对齐与速度驱动着 Meta 和 Anthropic 的文化。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so rewrite team norms and kill stale processes.
views.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；因此要重写团队规范，砍掉过时流程。

views.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs, and AI-generated PRs settle technical debates instead of whiteboards.
views.zh: 规划应即时化，设计文档让位于 PR，用 AI 生成多个 PR 来裁决技术争论，而非白板辩论。

views.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep street cred and agility.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，以维持可信度与敏捷性。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and apprenticeship matter as agents blur roles.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着智能体模糊角色边界，高能动性配高问责、验证框架与学徒制变得关键。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心。

views.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
views.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步需要算法创新，并把推理时算力当作新的扩展轴。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
views.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为，长上下文窗口则充当工作记忆。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but demand exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning remain key missing capabilities.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习与元学习仍是关键缺失能力。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，后训练与强化学习仍是广阔蓝海。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the year's biggest update.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死、预训练是必须重建的肌肉，而自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

views.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and mission, not dollar-matching Meta, protect top researchers.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；留住顶尖研究者靠人才密度与使命信念，而非与 Meta 逐美元对拼。

views.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision, but verification is the bottleneck and capability stays jagged, so human-AI collaboration remains essential.
views.zh: 2026 年初他转向数学：AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈、能力参差不齐，人机协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles where grading is subjective.
views.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在评分主观的领域吃力。

views.en: AGI is approaching as models near end-to-end research; evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks, and models still lack research taste.
views.zh: 2026 年中他判断 AGI 临近、模型将能做端到端研究；评测体系陷入危机、基准饱和，而模型仍缺乏研究品味，想法生成还得靠人。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to safety and generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，开源与数据共享是安全与泛化的关键。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐才是关键安全层。

views.en: Open source models win long-term on cost and control; in 2026 they stay near frontier and drive enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：开源模型凭成本与控制力长期胜出，2026 年已贴近前沿并推动企业采用。

views.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; a deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs open science and cooperation.
views.zh: 2026 年他新增担忧：无人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客，理想是审慎放缓，但需开放科学与国际合作。

views.en: Closed models are less controllable than assumed; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
views.zh: 2026 年他反转共识：闭源模型未必更可控，推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not a single monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得所需全部能力。

views.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习使模型能力参差不齐，擅长特定任务而非普遍提升；RAG 对复杂理解来说很原始，需要智能体式搜索和神经检索。

views.en: Open models are essential for safety, security, and broad access; openness is the default safe state, as with encryption.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放模型对安全、保障和广泛获取前沿智能至关重要；开放是技术的默认安全状态，如同加密和网络安全。

views.en: Reinforcement learning on top of strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency gains are still rapid.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：在强大预训练之上进行强化学习是通往能力强、效率高的智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升。

views.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow; open models benefit the world.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转变对齐观：对齐是平凡的漏洞修补，而非神奇公式；更多眼睛让漏洞变浅；中国开放模型有益世界并提供健康竞争。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools speed up science but don't replace scientists.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学但不会取代科学家。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability isn't necessary for useful AI in science.
views.zh: 置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；可解释性不必完美，AI 在科学中依然有用。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：成功靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），是许多中等突破而非一两个大突破。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding remains with humans.
views.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全与体验至关重要；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，更小的模型配合更好的推理算法可在特定任务上胜过更大模型。

views.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; language remains the best medium for reasoning, but current models fail simple reasoning tasks children solve.
views.zh: 同年她指出下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位；语言仍是推理的最佳媒介，但当前模型连儿童能解的简单推理都会失败。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate rather than transcend human knowledge, and RL needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈：现有方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，强化学习需精心工程才能胜过监督微调。

views.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are essential to compete with closed frontier labs; abductive reasoning and falsification drive scientific discovery beyond induction and deduction.
views.zh: 她同时强调开放研究与跨机构合作是对抗封闭前沿模型的必要条件，并主张溯因推理与证伪比假设生成更关键，推动科学发现超越归纳与演绎。

views.en: Small language models with diverse, filtered synthetic data and RL during pre-training can rival frontier models; pluralistic alignment beats trying to debias the internet.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步主张：小模型借助多样且经过滤的合成数据、以及预训练阶段的强化学习即可比肩前沿模型；多元对齐优于试图消除互联网偏见。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs, learning from video toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年：AI 应扩展人类能力；像 Gato 这样的通才智能体将所有输入 token 化，从视频中学习，迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: AI safety is the biggest challenge; we lack solutions, but Africa can leapfrog via local-language models and inclusion.
views.zh: 2026 年：AI 安全是最大挑战，我们尚无解决方案；但非洲可通过本地语言模型和包容性实现跨越式发展。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
views.zh: 2020 年，他把泛化视为智能的核心缺口：真正的关键不是依赖密集奖励的强化学习，而是无目标、好奇心驱动的探索，才能跳出训练分布。

views.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static demos to dynamic, sample-efficient policies that transfer across morphologies.
views.zh: 同年他强调机器人学习要从准静态演示走向动态任务，用样本高效、可跨形态迁移的策略，而非依赖仿真到现实的隐藏工程。

views.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, bound progress in machine learning and robotics.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：制约机器学习与机器人进步的是数据与泛化，而非单纯算法。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem: with no internet of robot data, pretraining on video and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人明确定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠视频与仿真的预训练加真实数据的后训练。

views.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any form factor; deployment, not demos, is the real technical challenge.
views.zh: 他进一步主张像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样做通用机器人大脑，可适配任意形态；并转向强调部署本身才是真正的技术挑战，而非演示。
